text.brief: A county clerk in Georgia needs a federal clearance in 2044 to certify local election software, a rule from an emergency declared in 2039 after a Party-linked cyberattack. The attack ended in a week, and the emergency did not.
text.record: The Brennan Center counted 52 national emergencies in effect on September 16, 2026. Presidents renew them each year without a vote in Congress. The Supreme Court struck down tariffs imposed under emergency powers on February 20, 2026 ([Supreme Court slip opinion, Learning Resources v. Trump (No. 24-1287)](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/25pdf/24-1287_4gcj.pdf)).
text.reading: The Party sows discord with attacks that invite an overreaction. Each emergency power that outlives its crisis divides Americans, and Party media call it proof that democracy is a mask. This is Stratagem 33, sow discord among the enemy.
text.coreEvent: An emergency declared over a cyberattack attributed to the Party stays in force for more than five years and reaches election administration before 2046.
text.gapText: Architecture Governance. Emergencies end only when the executive chooses, and renewal needs no vote.
text.fix: Make every emergency expire unless Congress votes to extend it.
